steps.title: A real cycle
steps.text: `obj.circleRef = obj` leads from the object back to itself, so both checks print `true`.
steps.textZh: `obj.circleRef = obj` 从对象出发又回到它自己，所以两种检查都打印 `true`。

steps.title: Shared is not circular
steps.text: An object used twice is not a cycle: following its properties never leads back to the start. The walk remembers only the objects on the current path, so it answers `false`.
steps.textZh: 一个对象被用了两次并不是循环：顺着属性走，永远回不到起点。遍历只记住当前路径上的对象，所以答案是 `false`。

action.run: const child = {}; const shared = { one: child, two: child }; console.log('shared child → isCycleByIterator:', isCycleByIterator(shared), '| isCycleByJSON:', isCycleByJSON(shared))

steps.actionLabel: Check an object that uses one child twice
steps.actionLabelZh: 检查一个把同一个子对象用了两次的对象
steps.expectConsole: shared child → isCycleByIterator: false | isCycleByJSON: false

steps.title: A failing JSON.stringify proves nothing
steps.titleZh: JSON.stringify 失败什么也证明不了
steps.text: `JSON.stringify` also throws for a `BigInt`, so the JSON check reports a cycle where there is none.
steps.textZh: `JSON.stringify` 遇到 `BigInt` 也会抛错，所以 JSON 检查会在没有循环的地方报告循环。

action.run: const big = { n: 1n }; console.log('BigInt value → isCycleByIterator:', isCycleByIterator(big), '| isCycleByJSON:', isCycleByJSON(big))

steps.actionLabel: Check an object with a BigInt
steps.actionLabelZh: 检查一个带 BigInt 的对象
steps.expectConsole: BigInt value → isCycleByIterator: false | isCycleByJSON: true
